title: Market-neutral long-short on F&O names via stock futures

costs.netting: long netted as the engine; short netted where the exiting and entering tranche hold the same contract, the overlap pays a roll (10 bps) where they hold different contracts; no_netting variant charges every tranche in full

amendments.A1: futures/cash break screen kept as a diagnostic, not an exclusion
amendments.A2: long leg's interior daily marks at adjusted closes (entry and exit at opens unchanged)

months.metric: mean net (costs) tranche return by signal month; excess = minus rf over 20 sessions

sensitivity_total_return.note: added after the results of record existed; changes no convention, book or pass mark
sensitivity_total_return.long_leg: cash dividends with ex-date session t+2..t+21 credited per rupee of entry (not reinvested)
sensitivity_total_return.short_leg: on contracts NSE adjusted for a dividend, the dividend is added back to the ex-date settle

dividends.rule: adjusted if dividend >= 2% of the previous unadjusted close and the ex-date futures-minus-cash return gap < 0.5 x the dividend yield

pass_mark.rule: net annualised Sharpe (rf 5.5%) >= 1.0 with its month-block 95% CI lower bound > 0, and beta to the Nifty 50 within +-0.2 on both the plain and the Dimson estimator

beta_sanity.note: cash equal-weight F&O universe against the Nifty 50 close-to-close return. With the engine's open-to-open marks the same-session beta understates the exposure and the Dimson sum recovers it; with interior close marks (amendment A2) the two estimators should agree
